The variable $z$ is being *multiplied* by $7.$ To isolate $z$, we perform the *opposite* operation, which is *dividing* by $7.$ Remember to perform the same operation on both sides.

$$
\begin{aligned}7z & <-21 \\ \frac{7z}{7} & <\frac{-21}{7} \\ \frac{7z}{7} & <-3\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can cancel a common factor of $7$ from the numerator and denominator.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{7z}{7} & <-3 \\ \frac{\cancel{7}z}{\cancel{7}} & <-3 \\ z & <-3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $z \lt -3.$
